notes: Trusts the screenshot over the noisy raw profile. Palette is a tight 5-role set: a cool lavender-white page (raw rgb(240,241,250) -> #f0f1fa, confirmed as the dominant non-white field), pure white chrome/cards, near-black ink, a dark slate STAGE surface (raw rgb(43,46,58) -> #2b2e3a, deepening toward #121416) that only ever appears inside the inset WebGL viewport, and one electric blue accent (raw rgb(26,47,251) -> #1a2ffb, with a deeper #0016ec for fills). 'muted' collapses onto the stage slate rather than a true mid-gray — there are no gray body tints; secondary text is the same near-black at reduced size. Type is single-family Aeonik (raw shows 96%+ Aeonik/400, a thin 500 for chrome labels). Scale normalized from raw px to rem at a ~1.5 ratio: body ~1rem(16px)/1.35rem(21.6px), then a large jump to the 2.7rem(43.2px) sub-display and 6.75rem(108px)/9rem(144px) hero display — the mid-scale is deliberately empty, so hierarchy is body-vs-huge. Display carries heavy negative tracking (raw -2.3px / -2.88px ~= -0.04em..-0.05em). Spacing base 8px with an 8/14.4/28.8 (x2) micro-scale for chrome/gaps and a coarse 50/72/168 macro-scale for section padding and the stage inset — bimodal, intermediate steps absent. Radius: 15px cards, 100px stadium pills, 10px small controls. Single soft ambient shadow used only on white floating chrome (the LETS TALK / menu pills); the dark stage has no shadow, separation is by inset + frame. Motion easing cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.1,1) (a fast-out S-curve) over 300-500ms drives hover/label transitions; the continuous tumbling of the 3D primitives, materials, lighting, and physics are WebGL and absent from computed-style tokens.
